description: Converts Unix file permissions between octal (755, 4755) and symbolic (rwxr-xr-x) form, shows the chmod command, explains who can read, write and run, and flags risky modes such as 777.

mode.description: Octal mode such as 644 or 4755, or symbolic mode such as rwxr-xr-x (a leading file-type character, as in -rwxr-xr-x, is accepted).

path.description: A file name to put in the chmod command. Defaults to filename.

name: chmod_calculator
title: chmod calculator
